messages.context: Chat log line. Both values are typed by players and may be in any script.
Approximate distance to the selected waypoint, in kilometres, shown with one decimal.
Running score in the top-right HUD corner.

messages.pattern: {count, plural, =0 {Your inventory is empty.} one {You have # item.} other {You have # items.}}
messages.context: Inventory panel summary; count includes equipped items.

messages.pattern: Type '{'name'}' to insert a name. Don't worry: it''s literal.
messages.context: Help text. The braces and the word name are shown to the player literally.

messages.pattern: {picker_gender, select, feminine {{count, plural, one {She picked up # coin.} other {She picked up # coins.}}} masculine {{count, plural, one {He picked up # coin.} other {He picked up # coins.}}} other {{count, plural, one {They picked up # coin.} other {They picked up # coins.}}}}
messages.context: Loot feed entry for a party member. picker_gender is the character's authored grammatical gender.
Main menu button that starts or resumes the game.
Title-screen edition subtitle. Markets may intentionally leave it empty.

messages.pattern: {count, plural, offset:1 =0 {Nobody is online.} =1 {{leader} is online.} one {{leader} and # other player are online.} other {{leader} and # other players are online.}}
messages.context: Friends panel. count includes the party leader; # shows the number of other players.

messages.pattern: {companion_gender, select, feminine {{companion} joined the party. She is ready.} masculine {{companion} joined the party. He is ready.} other {{companion} joined the party. They are ready.}}
messages.context: Quest log entry. companion is an authored character name; companion_gender is its authored grammatical gender.

messages.pattern: You finished {place, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}}.
messages.context: Race results banner with the player's finishing position.
